# Setup



```{r}
library(reticulate)

# Import Python modules into R variables
#py_install(c("arraylake))
py_install(c("arraylake")) 
xr   <- import("xarray")
np   <- import("numpy")
pd   <- import("pandas")
time <- import("time")
arraylake <- import("arraylake")
client <- arraylake$Client()
```

```{r}
# assign months, latitudes, and depths to filter
# all are integers, depths are in meters
# filters are inclusive (closed interval), e.g. depth 0-180 includes depths 0 and 180 and every depth between

lifestage_dict <- list(
  spawn = list( # spawn
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 3,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 36,
    min_depth = 130,
    max_depth = 500
  ), #long extent shelf break
  egg = list( # egg
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 3,
    min_lat   = 40,
    max_lat   = 60,
    min_depth = 40,
    max_depth = 60
  ), #long extent shelf break
  yolk = list( # yolk
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 4,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 36,
    min_depth = 50, 
    max_depth = 100 
  ), #long extent shelf break
  JAc = list( # JAc
    min_month = 1,
    max_month = 4,
    min_lat   = 34.5,
    max_lat   = 42.5,
    min_depth = 30,
    max_depth = 130
  ),
  latelarv = list( # latelarv
    min_month = 3,
    max_month = 6,
    min_lat   = 31,
    max_lat   = 37,
    min_depth = 50,
    max_depth = 300
  ),
  late = list( # late
    min_month = 3,
    max_month = 6,
    min_lat   = 33.5,
    max_lat   = 34.5,
    min_depth = 75,
    max_depth = 275
  )
)

```

```{r echo=FALSE}

library(ncdfCF)
url <- "https://compute.earthmover.io/v1/services/dap2/NOAA-PMEL/cefi-nep-hindcast-monthly/main/regrid/aux1/opendap"
ds <- open_ncdf(url)

# The double brackets extract these as dataset to keep the same structure as the previous code.
# look at the variables
names(ds)

# Lazy load
ds_mld <- ds[['MLD_003']]
ds_temp = ds[['thetao']]
ds_xv = ds[['uo_rotate']]
ds_yv = ds[['vo_rotate']]
ds_ssh = ds[['ssh_rotate']]
```



```{r echo=FALSE}
# Lazily load the entire dataset
library(ncdfCF)
url <- "https://compute.earthmover.io/v1/services/dap2/NOAA-PMEL/cefi-nep-hindcast-monthly/main/regrid/main/opendap"
ds <- open_ncdf(url)

# look at the variables
names(ds)

# Lazy load
vo <- ds[["vo_rotate"]]

# Let's check dimnames
dimnames(vo)

# Let's get surface for one time-step
# Takes about 1.6 seconds for me, so 10 min for the whole thing and 0.9 Gb
system.time({
  vo_surface_t1 <- vo[, , 1, 1]
})

## Try a smaller area
lon_axis <- ds[["lon"]]
lat_axis <- ds[["lat"]]

lon <- lon_axis$coordinates
lat <- lat_axis$coordinates

## Bounding box
lon_min <- 220
lon_max <- max(lon)
lat_min <- 20
lat_max <- 48

##
# https://r-cf.github.io/ncdfCF/articles/ncdfCF.html
(vo_sub <- vo$subset(z_l = 2.5, 
                     lon = c(lon_min, lon_max), 
                     lat = c(lat_min, lat_max),
                     time = 2025))


## this works
lon <- ds[["lon"]]$coordinates
lat <- ds[["lat"]]$coordinates

lon_idx <- which(lon >= lon_min & lon <= lon_max)
lat_idx <- which(lat >= lat_min & lat <= lat_max)

vo_surface_bbox <- vo[lon_idx, lat_idx, 1, ]
```
